app.tagline: Bulk screenshot tool for responsive testing

target.heading: Capture target
target.fullpageHint: Scroll to the bottom of the page and capture the whole thing
target.viewportHint: Capture only the first view, side by side
target.elementHint: Crop tightly to any block on the page
target.selectElement: Open browser and select an element

output.heading: Output settings
output.pngHint: Export the target as a single image
output.gifHint: Record animations such as clicks and interactions
output.manualInteractionHint: Shows a "Ready" button in the browser before capture. Open hidden modals or type text, then start the recording/capture yourself.
output.startDelayHint: Waits this many seconds after starting before capture begins.
output.gifDurationHint: Records the target for the given duration at about 3 fps.

widths.heading: Screen widths to capture
widths.heightAutoHint: Uses the default viewport height (1080 px). When on, the aspect ratio below is not used.

frames.heading: Device frames
frames.intro: Captures at the device's resolution and saves a PNG composited into the frame (PNG output only — not available for GIF).
frames.hint: ① Click "Open official site" to open Apple Design Resources in your browser. ② Download the Product Bezels (DMG) for the devices you need (iPhone / iPad / MacBook / iMac / Studio Display) — progress shows in your browser's downloads (the app does not download anything itself). ③ Pick the downloaded DMG file with "Import DMG / PNG" to import it.
frames.license: Use Apple's bezels under Apple's license, at your own responsibility. Adding a shadow counts as a modification under Apple's guidelines. The Pixel frames are derived from AOSP (Apache 2.0).

status.listFailed: Failed to load the frame list: {error}
status.dirFailed: Failed to get the import folder: {error}

status.selectWidthOrDevice: Select at least one width or device to capture.
status.selectWidthForGif: Select at least one width for GIF.
status.selectingElement: Launching browser... click an element to select it.

overlay.intro:
Interact with the page to reveal hidden elements or enter text,
then press the button below.
overlay.ready: You can interact with the page now...
